# Pinned Blender for the content build. tools/bake.sh verifies the hash before use.
#
# Pinned to an exact binary rather than a version range because bpy is a stateful
# tool whose defaults and operators shift between releases; version pinning is what
# buys back determinism. The bpy pip wheel is a documented fallback, but the binary
# is preferred: the wheel hard-couples Blender's minor version to a specific CPython,
# which makes agent sandboxes fragile.
#
# Verified working 2026-08-09: headless geometry, custom float attributes, smart UV
# project, Cycles CPU AO bake, GLB export — all green in ~0.8 s for a test mesh.
